patch_description: Two targeted improvements: (1) Add more diverse seeds — in particular boundary-of-triangle placements (vertices plus interior arc), since optimal 13-point Heilbronn configurations tend to place points on the convex hull vertices and edges of a triangle, and more random restarts increase basin coverage. (2) Add a final intensive fine-grained polish phase applied to the overall best configuration after basin hopping: a dedicated fine hill-climb (step sizes from 0.02 down to 5e-4, including diagonal coordinate moves) that can squeeze out the last area improvements on the smallest triangles. This complements the elite-ladder basin hopping without replacing it.
